content.short: The Refresh is a pioneering on-chain dynamic art project on Cardano where visuals change with every refresh.
content.description: The Refresh is a technically advanced dynamic art project built directly on the Cardano blockchain. Unlike traditional NFTs stored on external servers, the artwork in this collection is generated by code living entirely on-chain. Each time the page is refreshed, the JavaScript-based engine recreates the design with new background gradients and object positions, ensuring that every interaction is unique. Closely tied to the Fre5sh Music and Alexandria Project initiatives, The Refresh showcases the potential for persistent, living digital art that leverages the security of the blockchain.
